normalization: absolute errors and total L1 divided by abs(U(N)-U(empty))
runtime_policy: Raw timings retained. Primary timing summary uses median and IQR; values above Q3+3*IQR are flagged, not deleted.
permutation_variance: Exact variance over the permutation-induced distribution: size is uniform on 0..n-1 and subsets are uniform conditional on size.
sampling_unit_warning: Thirty seeds repeat algorithm randomness on one fixed game instance; they are not independent data environments.
